thread:
Sasha: Quick follow-up from the GPU autoscaling postmortem — want to lock down owners/timelines for the remediation items. TL;DR: quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom plan need owners.
Marc: I can take the scheduler tuning work. Plan to run a set of controlled canaries next week.
Jia: I'll own the quota request and liaise with cloud infra. ETA end of week for initial request.
Olivia: I'll draft the headroom plan (how much reserved capacity across zones + burst policy). Will post a draft by Thu.
Sasha: Thanks. Can we make concrete due dates? We need things tracked in the incident follow-up board.
Marc: Scheduler tuning: testing Mon-Wed, roll small changes Thu, monitor Fri. So target rollout by next Fri (7 days).
Jia: Quota request submitted by Fri EOD, expect cloud response ~7-10 days. If they push back we have contingency to defer non-critical batch jobs.
Olivia: Headroom doc draft Thu, internal review Fri, finalize next Tue. I'll include numbers for 5%, 10%, 15% headroom and cost delta.
Tanvi: Noted recurring pattern: autoscaler thrashes when a single model load spikes mem and all pods try to scale; we should add a sticky cache idea to reduce simultaneous cold starts. Assigning to SRE we should prototype.
Sasha: Good catch — can you add that as an action item? Owner?
Tanvi: I'll take prototype ownership with help from Marc for tuning. Timeline 2 weeks for POC.
Marc: For scheduler tuning: propose we change binpacking threshold from 0.75 -> 0.85 for GPU jobs and add a cooldown of 45s. Small bump but prevents premature preemption.
Jia: For quota we should request a pool-per-region approach rather than single global quota. I'll include that in the ticket.
Olivia: Headroom plan will include fallback routing to other regions and a policy for automatic model fallback to a smaller quantized variant when headroom < X%.
Sasha: Can everyone paste task IDs once created so I can link in the postmortem? Also add owners and acceptance criteria.
Marc: Created task: INFRA-2291 for scheduler tuning (owner: Marc). Acceptance: no more than 2 scale-thrash incidents in 14d of rollout.
Jia: Created task: INFRA-2292 for quota request (owner: Jia). Acceptance: quota increase granted or documented fallback plan.
Olivia: Created task: INFRA-2293 headroom policy (owner: Olivia). Acceptance: policy approved by SRE + one dry-run test across staging clusters.
Tanvi: Created task: INFRA-2294 sticky-cache-prototype (owner: Tanvi). Acceptance: 30% reduction in concurrent cold starts in POC.
Sasha: ops-bot — please set a reminder for the follow-up meeting in 7 days and add a weekly review for GPU incidents for 8 weeks.
ops-bot: Reminder set: Follow-up meeting in 7 days (channel: #incidents). Weekly review scheduled every Mon 09:30 for 8 occurrences.
Jia: One more note — quota doc will include burst profile and expected steady-state consumption over Q2. I'll attach usage graphs when I submit.
Olivia: I'll add cost estimates for headroom levels and a decision matrix (safety vs cost).
Marc: During canary we should capture these metrics: pod startup latency, GPU utilization tail p95, eviction count, and API 95 latency.
Tanvi: Agree — I'll add dashboards.
Sasha: Recurring incident pattern: looks like weekend batch spikes + model reloads during deployments. Action: add scheduling windows for heavy batch jobs and disallow model reloads during peak hours.
Olivia: I'll add proposed windows to headroom doc.
Jia: If quota approval is slow, short-term mitigation: restrict batch concurrency + enable prefix KV cache for models with big KV.
Marc: We should also add a change to the autoscaler: prefer scale-out with staggered ramps (e.g., 4s between pod starts) to avoid simultaneous node pressure. I'll include that in INFRA-2291.
Sasha: Great. Let's reconvene after Fri's rollout and update the postmortem with status per ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
